name: MVW Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Decided by a pole-climb Capture the Flag hardcore brawl on the fed's own "Power Hour" pilot episode (21 May 1998), the first title established under that show's own name.

name: MVW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Vacated ahead of the promotion's 2001 return and settled by a sixteen-man, two-night tournament, The Ascension, that Owen Neo won by beating Rage in the final.

name: MVW Television Championship
epitaph: Held by "Legacy" Paul Kiljoy in a 1998 unification match with a rival promotion's own Television title, and won by Snow from a champion and one other challenger in a 2001 three-way.

name: MVW Empire State Championship
epitaph: Introduced in early 2001 and won by Donovan Keltrane, who kept it through a non-title loss to Dick LeBaron weeks later.
